dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago. : Sula Islands and Buru
dct_description_sm: From Netherlands Government charts to 1933 ; Published at the Admiralty 14th April 1937, under the Superintendence of Rear Admiral J. A. Edgell. C.B.,O.B.E., Hydrographer.
Relief shown by form lines, spot heights; depths by soundings.
Includes Tidal Information table, British Units - Metres table, Caution note on firing practices.
Soundings are in fathoms, heights in feet.
Shows depths, low water areas, reefs, buildings.
At head of title is Hydrographic Office seal
